text: Desperate for money, Gordon Fleming promises to clear the asbestos from the abandoned Danvers State Hospital in a single week, and leads his small crew into [its crumbling wards and tunnels|images|buildings and public places]. A disembodied voice greets him by name. Mike finds nine taped therapy sessions with Mary Hobbes, [a patient of many voices|threat|the enemy within], and plays them one after another, while Hank goes missing in the basement and Gordon, haunted by [slapping his wife|wrong|cruelty at home], drifts further from himself.
